provenIsTheOnlyClassificationThatCanOpen: COMPLETE_PACKET_PROVEN is set from the fulfillment record and from nothing else, and every other classification leaves the route refused at all six commercial surfaces. COMPLETE_PACKET_PROVEN_COMMERCIALLY_HELD is a proven packet whose postures are still closed: it opens nothing either.
finding: The direct-consumer paid path has one artifact builder and it takes no branch. buildConsumerPacketArtifact returns provider rcap_source_engine, contentType text/plain and a filename ending -packet.txt for every jurisdiction, route, packet family and plan mode, and its body is the route's own metadata plus the packet plan's readiness conditions under a heading that reads FILING CHECKLIST. So the § 99-15-59 finding is a property of the path, not of that route.

departuresFromTheCommercialDenominator.note: Routes that were in this census and no longer are, each with the exact reason. A denominator that changes silently is not a denominator.
departuresFromTheCommercialDenominator.reconciliation: The previous census carried 54 commercial routes. 25 left when ADR-0004 withdrew the legacy generators' credit-consumability, and 1 entered on a fulfillment record rather than on a commercial capability. 54 - 25 + 1 = 30.

rows.exactRemainingDelta: The packet is proven (nd-first-offense-possession-sealing v1.0.0, provider rcap_grade_a_composer_v1, application/pdf). Consumer posture held, sponsored posture held. Three things are outstanding and every one of them is a reason a participant should not yet be charged. (1) No counsel has reviewed the composed document set. Machine verification proves the packet is complete against its own specification; it says nothing about whether the specification is legally right. (2) Page-image review has not happened: this container has no PDF rasteriser, so the packet was reviewed as composed content and as parsed PDF structure rather than as rendered pages. (3) The specification records a gap in the approved legal design — neither the registry's required inputs nor the packet-set manifest names a first-offense confirmation, though the statute makes first-offense status an element and the motion asserts it. The fact is now collected and confirmed, and the gap belongs in the next legal-design review of this route. Opening either posture is an owner decision, not a consequence of this record existing.
